History_of_Present_Illness.content: Diarrhea for 3 days, occurring 4-5 times per day
Diarrhea consists of mixed watery and loose stools
No blood or mucus in stools

History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No recent travel or unusual diet

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reduced appetite but still eating and drinking adequately
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Reduced appetite but still eating and drinking adequately

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No medications taken yet for diarrhea or pain
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No medications taken yet for diarrhea or pain

Medications.content: Patient uses a yellow inhaler for asthma

Family_History.content: Father died of bowel cancer at age 62

Assessment.content: Acute diarrhea, likely infectious or dietary, mild dehydration risk
Assessment.source_text: 1. Acute diarrhea, likely infectious or dietary, mild dehydration risk

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise soft diet including crackers, toast, and jam, and to avoid dairy, meat, and eggs initially
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advise soft diet: crackers, toast, jam; avoid dairy, meat, eggs initially

Plan_of_Care.content: Introduce boiled vegetables and mash after 48 hours of symptom improvement
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Introduce boiled vegetables and mash after 48h symptom improvement

Plan_of_Care.content: Reintroduce meat, eggs, and fish only after 48 hours diarrhea-free
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Reintroduce meat, eggs, fish only after 48h diarrhea-free

Plan_of_Care.content: Recommend probiotic yogurts and avoid milk
Encourage adequate hydration and consider Dioralyte for electrolyte replacement
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Encourage adequate hydration; consider Dioralyte for electrolyte replacement

Plan_of_Care.content: Monitor stool frequency and seek care if more than 8 stools per day or if blood in stool
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Monitor stool frequency; seek care if >8 stools/day or blood in stool

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange stool sample if diarrhea persists for more than 1 week or if blood appears
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Stool sample if diarrhea persists >1 week or blood appears

Plan_of_Care.content: Educate patient on warning signs and app note review
